export_model_torchscript: export a detectron2 model to TorchScript format using the tracing export method
export_model_onnx: export a detectron2 model to ONNX format using the caffe2_tracing export method
export_model_caffe2: export a detectron2 model to Caffe2 protobuf format using the caffe2_tracing export method
run_export_evaluation: run evaluation on an exported model using the COCOEvaluator and inference_on_dataset
setup_detectron2_config: setup a detectron2 config from a config file with command-line options and pointrend support
